notes.title: Alpha 1.6.2
notes.content:
Hotfix!

Changes:
- Rainy forest now also apply entangling vines

Fixes:
- Fixed heirloom shelf issue

notes.title: Alpha 1.6.1
notes.content:
Changes:
- Reduced xp requirements for unlocks
- Added new skill assets
- Changed random seed system
- Ceta can now scam customers
- Doors now permanently have iterations

Fixes:
- Fixed tutorial run not giving xp
- Fixed fake player not showing particles on death
- Fixed projectiles interacting with portals
- Fixed case where multiple fanfare occurs
- Fixed fragile mushroom animation
- Fixed lightning shots not applying to echoes
- Localized hard mode setting

notes.title: Alpha 1.6.0
notes.content:
We did a lot of work.

Changes:
- Added XP cause amount to score screen
- Added iteration count to screen
- Added iteration bar to door iteration item
- Added visuals to indicate spectral dynamites
- Added falling sound on tiles
- Added debug button to show/hide specific UI
- Added localization support
- Added new item: Fate's shield
- Added the parlor on break room
- Added soul statue on break room
- Added actual icons on challenges
- Added new progression xp unlockables
- Changed item pick screen into luxurious UI
- Changed score screen most used persona to be more detailed
- Changed game over music
- Changed challenges to appear on appropriate levels and always unique portals
- Unlocks now show a fanfare
- Replaced Hard Mode temporary icon
- Fading Echoes now actually fade
- Reworked Jester controls
- Casting bar is now hidden before unlocking skill
- Echoes now has a light on lights out

Fixes:
- Fixed rare cases where bullets pass through collision
- Fixed case where crashing restarts progress or starts as a replay
- Fixed edge case where killing an enemy then dying softlocks
- Fixed jester's projectile not colliding properly
- Fixed case where giving up when stage is cleared causes softlock
- Fixed waterfall sound playing before level was loaded
- Fixed bullet breaker's stacking effect on echo respawn

New Upgrades:
Fate's Shield - not currently available
- Fate’s Shield Every 4/3 iterations, gain a shield that blocks one instance of damage (paladin shield passive). The shield does not go away on the next iteration. Once used, it will count back up starting from 1.
Floaty Draft - not currently available
- You can now glide in the air for a brief period of time when holding jump. Max glide duration 0.5/0.8/1.2s
Miniaturizer - not currently available
- Shrinks the character and their hitbox by x%/y%

Balances:
Ceta found some new items on the ground (prices listed are without discounts)
Fancy Grab Bag
- Costs 700
Amulet of Time
- Costs 450
Feather Amulet
- Costs 300
Imaginative Orb
- Costs 350
Swift Scroll
- Costs 250
Rainy Forest
- Starts with initial delay
- Movement slow reduced to 30% (50% -> 30%)
Hunter skill was too generic
- Costs 400
- Reworked into passive skill `Skill: Stalking Prey`, gains invulnerability upon not moving for 1 second
Alchemist skill was reworked
- Costs 750
- Reworked into active skill `Skill: Time Stop`, stops time for 2 seconds
Skill: Swift Step somehow lost its invulnerability
- Skill: Swift Step: Invulnerable duration (0 -> 0.2)

notes.title: Alpha 1.5.1
notes.content:
Hotfix!

Fixes:
- Fixed text input prompts to now refresh every 5 seconds, preventing text not updating
- Fixed seeing double challenge to no longer count revive as odd/even iteration
- Fixed only rogue abilities working

notes.title: Alpha 1.5.0
notes.content:
Levels now end with a portal, introducing a future mechanic: challenge (not available yet in build)

Changes:
- Added keybinding on settings
- Added animation to mushroom
- Added waterfall sound
- Added parallex on lobby
- Added lighting and particles on all forest maps and adjusted bloom
- Added shadow behind player on lobby
- Changed attack and skill demo to platform instead of solid tiles to display full attacks
- Reworked item drops on level to include rarity and duplicate item drops
- Reworked tutorial guiding line and prompts
- Death particles now interact with levels
- Mirror now shows interacting message instead of being uninteractable when characters  0/100/900/3500)

Fixes:
- Fixed case where enemy cannot be seen on forest level (due to lighting issues)
- Fixed getting stuck on end screen

notes.title: Alpha 1.4.0
notes.content:
A lot of feedbacks were received for controls and tutorial, hopefully this version solves this along with polishing other details as well as reduce shop item prices (maybe Ceta wanted a quick buck).

Changes:
- Added lighting on lobby
- Added camera shake and haptics on death
- Added attack and skill demo on deck selection
- Added gate hover visuals
- Added walking sound
- Added unlock sound
- Added purchase sound
- Added red outline on dangerous objects
- Added tip text on title screen
- Added Danger Sense item for attack warnings
- Added Danger Sense item for movement warnings
- Added door iteration count
- Added button prompt on first cutscene
- Added button prompt on fanfare
- Added button prompt on main menu
- Added button prompt on shop and deck selection
- Added item description during fanfare
- Changed timer color above door to gradient
- Changed timer color above player to match player
- Changed door and player attack timer
- Removed timers above echoes
- Merged tutorial into one streamlined level
- Fully supported controller and switching mid-game

Balances:
- Clockwork Charm: Cost reduced (500 -> 250)
- Collector's Pendant: Cost reduced (700 -> 300)
- Hourglass of Shadow: Cost reduced (500 -> 150)
- Rune of Rebirth: Added another level (Revives added 1/2 -> 1/2/3)
- Rune of Rebirth: Cost reduced, added another level (100/3000 -> 100/900/3500)
- Skill: Swift Step: Cost reduced (1000 -> 150)
- Skill: Double Jump: Cost reduced (1800 -> 280)
- Skill: Shield: Cost reduced (3000 -> 750)
- Skill: Wall Climb and Jump: Cost reduced (2100 -> 500)

Fixes:
- Fixed dying on 1-3 locks paladin and jester permanently
- Fixed souls not being rounded on stats screen
- Fixed fanfare not appearing instantly on shop
- Fixed main menu sound looping incorrectly
